events.author: s_63h0z_rn9tGX5c93aI9sgKHb1iJO4JwP9NvPMuXsE
events.body:
## Summary

Turn the current landing-page visual direction into the universal BLT-Jobs design system for every public page.

Issue blt-jobs#1 already tracks the landing page UI. This issue extends that direction across jobs, job details, seekers, seeker profiles, saved jobs, contribution flows, board health, and future docs pages.

## Scope

- Reusable shell/header/footer.
- BLT red primary action system.
- Card, form, filter, badge, empty-state, and status patterns.
- Git-native source/traceability components.
- Responsive and accessible layouts.
- Consistent dark/light mode behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Document the BLT-Jobs page/component design principles under `docs/`.
- [ ] Reuse the current landing-page UI as the design foundation, not as a one-off page.
- [ ] Define shared patterns for cards, buttons, filters, badges, source links, empty states, and footer.
- [ ] Update all pages to follow the same shell and visual rhythm.
- [ ] Replace raw broken states such as `Unable to load...` with polished fallbacks.
- [ ] Verify responsive behavior and keyboard navigation on all primary pages.

## Parent

Tracked by #12: https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/2

---
